subject: gc_worker: Fix the problem that GC may kill the transaction whose start ts is exactly the same as the txn safe point (#64663)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent focusing on store behavior. The change adjusts GC lock resolution to treat the txn safe point as lower-exclusive by passing `txnSafePoint-1` as ScanLock/ResolveLocksForRange maxVersion, aligns unistore ScanLock behavior to inclusive maxVersion, and adds a regression test. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched store code under the requested criteria.
